personality.description: This person tends to approach daily tasks with careful planning, strong attention to detail, and a preference for doing things thoroughly and in an orderly way. They are highly imaginative and curious, so they enjoy exploring new ideas, but they usually do so privately or with a small, trusted circle rather than in large, energetic settings. When faced with moral dilemmas, they are likely to respond with empathy and a strong desire to protect harmony, yet they may worry intensely about making the wrong choice and replay possible outcomes in their mind. In group discussions, they usually speak quietly, listen closely, and choose words carefully, often helping others feel heard while avoiding open disagreement.
